name: Chorister Felix

intro.text: I'm in the Magdalen choir. On May Morning I sing from the top of the tower at six in the morning, in a surplice, in the cold, with a hangover from the night before. It's glorious.

win: A cappella defeat. I'll go and stand on a tower and think about it.
after: On 1 May at six the choir sings the Hymnus Eucharisticus from Magdalen Tower. There's morris on the street, the bells ring and people jump into the Cherwell off the bridge. Not any more, it's roped off. They did, a lot.
